The Your Level Up Program is designed for entrepreneurs in the growth stage of business.

Program details: Location: Hybrid at The DEC Network at Redbird Date: September 1 st – November 10 th Time: Tuesdays from 4:30 PM – 6:30 PM Requirements: For-profit 2–3 years in business Generating $50k or more annually apply here The Thrive Accelerator Program is designed for entrepreneurs who are ready to scale with intention – not just grow faster.
Benefits: 1-1 mentorship with experienced business professionals Strengthen your operations Expand Your Network Get access to capital opportunities And more!
Location: The DEC Network at Fort Worth 600 Bryan Ave, Suite 220, Fort Worth, TX 76104 The Big iDEA accelerator program is for founders in the ideation pre revenue phase of business.
This bootcamp style program is four sessions dedicated to guiding the founder as they prepare to pitch their idea.

Camp Wisdom Rd, STE 200, Dallas, TX 75237 Benefits: Mentorship from a successful business owner or high-level executive through The DEC Network Access to exclusive membership events and workshops Opportunity to pitch for cash prizes And more!
The program concludes with the Big iDEA Pitch Competition .
The top eight entrepreneurs present their business concept to a live audience and a panel of judges, competing for cash awards to help accelerate their venture’s growth.

Mentorship Opportunities Your Business, Backed by Experience At The DEC Network, our Mentorship Program connects entrepreneurs directly with seasoned business leaders and industry experts who volunteer their time to help you navigate the hurdles of scaling a business.

Through structured accelerator programs and one-on-one advisory connections, mentees receive tactical guidance, strategic feedback, and crucial insights to help avoid costly mistakes and fast-track their growth.
Whether you are validating an early-stage idea or preparing to secure capital, our mentoring network provides the trusted human capital needed to turn obstacles into major business milestones.
